title: Video RE question bank: Colour and grade
summary: 32 answerable questions for reverse-engineering a video's colour and grade, each with evidence to cite, the format-IR pointer it fills and a challenge prompt.
description: Measures palette, luminance range, saturation, temperature and consistency, and turns them into a reproducible grade recipe. Every question says why it matters, how to answer it from evidence.json or targeted ffmpeg extracts, the evidence required, the JSON pointer it fills in the Video format IR, the answer type and how a sceptic would test the answer. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

review.notes: Generator checks ids, fields, answer types, enum choices, IR pointers against the format IR schema, evidence field names, recipe codes and near-duplicate questions.
